title: Ferrate–acetylacetonate system to promote the degradation of sulfadimethoxine in mariculture tailwater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,891-902
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00832D, Paper
Hongwei Sun, Zheng Li, Qiankun Du, Hanzhang Li, Hua Su, Jiamin Lin, Yuyi Zheng, Kaicong Cai, Shuangcheng Jiang, Changqing Liu, Chunshan Wu
Fe(VI)–AA has good removal effect on SDM in mariculture tailwater, which provides a new idea for the removal of antibiotics in mariculture tailing water.
